title: Construction.
bodyText: This part shall be construed to effect the purpose under section 431:16-102 which will constitute an aid and guide to interpretation.
bodyHtml: §431:16-104  Construction.  This part shall be construed to effect the purpose under section 431:16-102 which will constitute an aid and guide to interpretation. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2; am L 2000, c 93, §3]
